Triage (first-touch grading, triage seat session `session_01HUGmbPVkYs22mNKmsDL6KT`): promoted `finding` → `pm:queue`, `domain:devx`, type Task.

Routing rationale (three-stream split for objectui cards): the fix lands in console **test engineering** — the `apps/console/vite.config.ts` source alias, the app-shell barrel's side-effect imports as seen by the test module graph, and/or the mock-factory `importOriginal` pattern — not in published-library or app product code, so this is the engineering face (`domain:devx`), not `domain:ui`. Note the devx@objectui seat is currently vacant (#10602); the card waits in queue — that is a staffing gap, not a routing input.

Dispatch shape (for whoever picks it up): first turn the 12-file upper bound into a measured count (per-file read of which mock factory the `importOriginal` sits in), then pick the cheapest lever that removes the ~10s per-file transform from bounded windows — the card's own three levers (alias to built output for tests, trim the barrel's 8 side-effect imports from the graph, or drop `importOriginal` for this package in factories) are engineering judgment within scope; ⛔ raising timeouts / heavyDomTests / skip-quarantine are explicitly not on the table, per the card and per gate-weakening rules. If measurement shows the real population is 1–2 files, report back — the card may then be below the line and worth closing rather than engineering around.

Size/model suggestion: M (measurement + one infra lever, judgment sits in design not gates).

- Domain: `domain:devx` (console test configuration; triage 2026-08-26 promoted finding → `pm:queue`, type Task, Size/model suggestion: M)
- File surface (measurement first, then at most one lever): read-only pass over the 12 candidate console test files listed in the card body (to attribute each `importOriginal` to the mocked module it sits in); then exactly one of — `apps/console/vite.config.ts` (the `@object-ui/app-shell` test alias), `packages/app-shell/src/index.ts` (the barrel's side-effect imports), or the affected files' `vi.mock('@object-ui/app-shell', …)` factories. Which lever is chosen follows from the measured count, per the triage comment.
- Container & model: subagent `os-dev`, opus, background.
- Clause ②: not applicable (no `packages/spec` contract surface; no published-package public API changes expected — if the barrel lever is chosen and it changes the export set of `@object-ui/app-shell`, the dev stops and reports instead of landing it).
- Serial constraints cleared: #6640 (PR #7304) touches root `vitest.setup.*` only; #7183 (PR #7291) touches root `vitest.config.mts` + `apps/console/vitest.config.ts` (not `vite.config.ts`); #7134 touches the unit isolate script; #6214 touches `scripts/check-readme-exports.*`; #5174 batch 6 touches `content/docs/**`. None overlaps the surface above. `vi.mock` factory edits are confined to the candidate console test files, which no in-flight card touches.

Rulings carried into the dispatch order (from the triage comment, verbatim in intent): raising timeouts, adding files to `heavyDomTests`, and skip/quarantine are explicitly not on the table. If measurement shows the real population is 1–2 files, the dev reports back with the measurement and no lever — the card may then be below the line.

ACCEPT — PR #7315 (head `3c8111cf4`), reviewed against GitHub by the `domain:devx` seat (session_01BGMDbrVa8JjZcCQ7DWYH1b, round R40).

Checked:
- Measurement first, as the triage comment required: per-factory attribution puts the real population at N = 3 (`FormPage.predicateScope`, `SetupRoute`, `StudioRoute`), the other nine candidates' `importOriginal` belonging to `approvalsApi` or `@object-ui/i18n`; ripgrep finds 22 mocking files against the code-search's 21. Cost re-measured on this tree at 10019 ms for the barrel vs 237 ms for `auth`, reproducing the card. Two structural figures corrected (barrel 447 lines / 13 side-effect imports).
- Exactly one lever, and the cheapest: (c), confined to the three test files. (a) ruled out by measurement (CI's test job runs no build, `dist` absent at test time). (b) stopped per the dispatch ruling (the 13 side-effect imports are the published barrel's registration behaviour).
- The replacement spreads the submodules the needed names live in, with a static coverage proof over each file's full transitive module graph (0 uncovered names per file) rather than the paths the tests happen to run; the `SetupRoute` `useMetadata`-through-the-barrel subtlety is spelled out in the factory rather than by a new cross-package edge.
- Before/after on the same three files from the repo root: import phase 13.07 s → 2.64 s, 37/37 tests both sides. Console type-check exit 0 with all three files confirmed in the program; eslint, control-bytes, changeset gates quoted with exit codes. Empty-frontmatter changeset present (harmless; nothing published changes).
- Nothing in `apps/console/vitest.config.ts`, root `vitest.config.mts` or `vitest.setup.*` touched; no timeout, no `heavyDomTests`, no skip.

The PR flips out of draft and enters the queue once CI on `3c8111cf4` is green. Card closes on merge via `Fixes #6580`. Follow-up not opened here: the remaining ~7.8 s of barrel graph is a property of the published package's side-effect imports, which the ruling kept out of this card; anyone who wants it measured files it as a finding against `packages/app-shell`.
